## Protected material / consumers
Preserve all other prose, inline comments, runtime strings, regexes, prompts, assertions, data, and executable AST. The 3 directive lines retain exact text and inline/next-code attachment; shebang count is 0. No selected docstring has a runtime documentation consumer. Pytest collects all 16 surviving modules; comment hygiene scans them.

## Independent receipt
An independent reviewer agent posts exactly 31 leaf-linked TSV rows through the shared MCP bot account. Independence means the reviewer agent did not author the code change:
`stable_id<TAB>full_before_SHA:path#ID<TAB>full_final_SHA:path#ID<TAB>contract_or_consumer<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>semantic_preservation<TAB>bloat_removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
Each has `after_words < before_words` and PASS in all 3 verdict columns. Missing/duplicate/extra, author-reviewed, short-SHA, or non-PASS rows block closure.
